assessments.evidence: The exact Marketplace listings F1607197917 and FR2314156865 show FedRAMP Certified, Rev5 Agency Class C Moderate since October 11, 2019 and Class D High since September 13, 2024. Both current public embedded package objects have empty certified_services arrays. Preserve the historical component lists and avoid inferring authorization loss or exclusion. In a Chromium render using the current publisher table and icon font, the column order is IL5, Moderate, High, GovRAMP, TX-RAMP. The February 2026 program matrix marks Platform and ES at Moderate/High, SOAR Cloud and SAIA at Moderate with blank High cells, and Observability Cloud components blank. Its legend qualifies feature inclusion and the next assessment cycle. The dated October 19 High announcement identifies Edge/Ingest Processor, SPL2 and assistant SPL authoring/explanation with eligible-stack onboarding conditions. Earlier matrix blanks do not contradict these later naming events. Platform authorization, exact feature eligibility, independent Observability authorization and SOAR High scope remain separately qualified.
assessments.qualification: Check both Marketplace entries against the vendor compliance scope and named feature/service rows. Keep product authorization, experience, rollout and customer eligibility distinct.

coverage.qualification: Both current 10.7 and 10.8 Supported versions tables name Platform 10.7, ES 8.7 and ITSI 5.0 for service subscriptions. This is separate from a quarterly release, upgrade onboarding or commercial entitlement. The ES 8.8 compatibility tables distinguish Premier integration from non-Premier pairing, Cloud-only same-provider scope, the conditional hybrid CA/ES 8.8 path and IL5/Windows limits. The SOAR 8.8 service details independently scope Moderate to AWS GovCloud East and West, require FIPS 140-3 validated modules and document limitations of playbook management and native on-premises-to-cloud migration. The November new-deployment retention milestone remains separate from service-date evidence and a blanket tenant rollout. The Observability realm-equivalence table maps us2 to Google Cloud Oregon, while its Database Monitoring row lists us2 and None under Google Cloud. Public uncertainty remains accurate. November 16 High ES UEBA, TIM and Detection Studio is scoped expansion: TIM/Detection Studio are included for Essentials and UEBA requires separate entitlement. It does not resolve SOAR High or independently authorize Observability.
